logline: An afternoon at a mountain temple: incense thin, stone warm, time unhurried.
youtubeTitle: QuietLY · 山寺午後 — Slow Mandarin Jazz

comics.en: Incense thins into the pine air.
Afternoon light stays on the courtyard.

tracks.lyrics:
[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

山門的石階很長
風把樹影放在腳邊
沒有人催促
一階
再一階

[Refrain — leave rests between lines]
慢慢上去
不要說話
慢慢上去
讓午後停一下

[Instrumental interlude — about 25 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
空山不見人
但聞人語響

[Original connective lines]
山門還開著
午後沒有遠去

[Final — sparse]
慢慢上去

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

松風從高處下來
把鐘聲吹得很淡
針葉在光裡晃動
像一句沒說完的話

[Refrain]
風過來
又過去
風過來
留下安靜

[Instrumental interlude — about 30 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
松風吹解帶
山月照彈琴

[Original connective lines]
我站在樹影裡
聽風把時間撥開

[Outro — short instrumental]

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

茶煙升得很慢
午後的光停在杯邊
一點香
散在石桌上

[Refrain]
別吹散
讓它再停一會
別吹散
讓香留下痕跡

[Instrumental interlude — about 25 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
獨坐幽篁裡
彈琴復長嘯

[Original connective lines]
山寺沒有催促
茶煙替人回答

[Final]
別吹散

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

[Female]
遠鐘從山後過來

[Male — after silence]
一下
又一下

[Both — soft, never a pop chorus]
不用走近
也能聽見

[Instrumental interlude — about 30 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry, alternating]
夜靜春山空
月出驚山鳥

[Original connective lines]
兩個聲音
隔著風回答

[Final — one line each]
遠鐘
還在

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

石橋跨過淺水
影子停在石頭上
水聲很輕
像有人走過又離開

[Refrain]
站一會兒
看水過去
站一會兒
不必趕路

[Instrumental interlude — about 30 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
清泉石上流
明月松間照

[Original connective lines]
橋上沒有人
只有風和光

[Outro — instrumental]

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

殿頂的雲很薄
像一層未乾的墨
午後還亮著
卻不刺眼

[Refrain]
雲過來
又散開
雲過來
留下一點灰藍

[Instrumental interlude — about 25 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
行到水窮處
坐看雲起時

[Original connective lines]
我抬頭看一眼
山把天空放低

[Final]
雲過來

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

空廊把腳步拉長
一聲
就變成兩聲
灰塵停在木柱上
沒有人開門

[Refrain]
慢慢走
讓回聲自己散
慢慢走
不要叫醒午後

[Instrumental interlude — about 30 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
返景入深林
復照青苔上

[Original connective lines]
廊外有松風
廊內有安靜

[Outro]

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

[Female — distant]
誰在遠處低聲

[Male]
不是對我說的

[Both — whispered overlap]
聲音穿過木門
留下很短的光

[Instrumental interlude — about 25 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
深林人不知
明月來相照

[Original connective lines]
兩個人各自聽見
午後沒有解釋

[Final — one shared soft phrase]
還在遠處

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

第一盞燈亮起來
還沒有到夜
石階上有一點暖
像有人剛離開

[Refrain]
燈影很淡
卻夠走完這一段
燈影很淡
不用照亮整座山

[Instrumental interlude — about 25 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
日暮蒼山遠
天寒白屋貧

[Original connective lines]
暮色還沒有來
燈先替它回答

[Outro — short instrumental]

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

下山的路比上去更靜
草葉擦過鞋邊
背後的鐘
漸漸變小

[Refrain]
慢慢走
不必回頭
慢慢走
把午後留下

[Instrumental interlude — about 30 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
白雲回望合
青靄入看無

[Original connective lines]
山還在身後
路已經向前

[Final]
慢慢走

[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

[Female]
我向有光的石階

[Male]
我向沒有鐘的小路

[Female]
風在身後變小

[Male]
山在前方變遠

[Both — sparse]
各路而行
各自保留午後

[Instrumental interlude — about 30 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry, alternating]
隨意春芳歇
王孫自可留

[Original connective lines]
不用回答
不用回頭

[Outro — voices overlap once only]
各路

tracks.voice: soft expressive female vocal with optional very faint male harmony only at the end
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro — instrumental; do not sing for about 15-25 seconds]

暮色還沒有到
山把聲音收好
最後一點茶煙
散在石階上

[Refrain — one line, then silence]
不要急著命名夜晚

[Instrumental interlude — about 30 seconds]

[Verse 2 — public-domain poetry]
江畔何人初見月
江月何年初照人

[Original connective lines]
今天還沒有結束
午後也沒有離開

[Final refrain — female once]
不要急著命名夜晚

[Instrumental outro — about 25 seconds, no vocal]
